notes.title: MAGEYE's Future + Development Update
notes.notes: [h3][b]Hello sightseers,[/b][/h3][p]Due to [b]some smelly circumstances[/b], I am becoming rather uncertain for this game's future. If you have not been [b]mindlessly wandering[/b] through [b]life[/b] as though in a haze you may have noticed a large amount of er... [b]silencing[/b] occurring throughout the [b]internet.[/b][/p][p][b]In relation to this[/b], I have not been revealing the full contents of this game for specific reasons and perhaps it is a good thing this game has yet to garner any sort of major attention prior to its release.[/p][p]The game's content is highly [b]controversial[/b], and I am bound to receive a few death threats for sure - I could not care less if I do. I am not going to quit development on the game due to previously stated causes, if anything this is [b]encouraging[/b] me to create this even more.[/p][p]Whether the game is [b]taken down[/b] or not, I do not think I could say I give much of a [b]fuck[/b]. You're all suffering with me. I'll continue working on this no matter the [b]cost.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Also... if you want to know how close the game is to being finished:[/b][/h3][p]I currently need to make [b]9[/b] more levels, add some more [b]NPCs[/b], maybe add a few [b]extras[/b] and do some other [b]monotonous[/b] dev stuff, then the game will hopefully be ready for [b]release![/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Cool vidz 4 magpie game!!!:[/b][/h2][p][b]Forgetting temporarily what I have said so that we may live without pure dread... [/b]here are some truly amazing, epic snippets for what's coming next! ;D[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="yuDXDcyHNm0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][previewyoutube="5gwWA9kR0ys;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]No goodbyes for you peoples.[/p][p][b]HONOR APATHY. (don't listen to it)[/b][/p]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes: [h3][b]Hello sightseers,[/b][/h3][p]I am here to transmit a message about how close the game is to being finished.[/p][p]So far, the game is [b]half-way[/b] done and it's been extremely hard to make this game, and I never thought I would have made it this far. I've rewritten it about [b]8[/b] times, and I think everyone will be crying tears of joy when you see the sights that await you...[/p][p]Especially at [b]the[/b] [b]end[/b]. ;)[/p][p][/p][p]Here are [b]two teasers[/b] that briefly showcase what's coming next:[/p][previewyoutube="ujTtYFZwaws;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][previewyoutube="qy1DrSDGZFg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]In case you missed it...[/b][/h3][p]You can ask this bloated, dying vessel questions about their upcoming game here:[/p][h3][b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3658230/discussions/0/664957733316948418/"]Q&A Discussion Thread[/url][/b][/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Anyway...[/b] the magpies grow louder, the wind is starting to kick in, and I have no more to say other than [b]goodbye[/b], and [b]remember to clean between your toes[/b]. Some nasty fucking odors can be found there![/p]

notes.title: A Big Thanks + Q&A
notes.notes: [h3]Hello sightseers,[/h3][p][/p][p]I would like to [b]thank[/b] everyone who shared the game, played the demo, wishlisted it, or checked it out during Next Fest. I wasn't expecting to even get 100 wishlists, but we ended up with [b]200 wishlists! [/b]So yeah, I guess I am pretty satisfied with everything, especially considering how rough the demo was and how weird and niche this whole thingamajig is.[/p][p][/p][h3]To celebrate, I am doing a [b]Q&A[/b] where I'll be able to answer any questions from any curious two leggeds:[/h3][h3][b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3658230/discussions/0/664957733316948418/"]Q&A [/url][/b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3658230/discussions/0/664957733316948418/"]Discussion Thread[/url][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Other stuffs:[/b][/h3][p]Next Fest aside, here's a little update on the game itself.[/p][p]Originally, this project was going to be much smaller. My initial plan was to release something short, just to see if people would enjoy what I have stored for the future. But I've since expanded the game, improved the story, and currently I have around [b]25 levels[/b] planned for the final game, and it will likely be [b]two hours long[/b].[/p][p]The final game will be [b]more polished[/b], but it will still retain a very minimalist feel. So don't expect some hyper-polished triple-A production, just know it'll feel better without losing any of its raw emotion.[/p][p]Expect [b]more two legged enemies[/b], and [b]a lot more trauma and grief[/b] in store,[b] as this gets far darker[/b] than the demo. ;)[/p][p]The game will likely be priced at around [b]$5[/b]. I'm doing my utmost to make this game something special, so that hopefully, when this thing is out, I am not being doxed and having rocks thrown at my window by people demanding their money back after release day. I hope people are satisfied with this when it is out.[/p][p][/p][p]Nothing else to say other than smell you later.[/p][p](HAHAHA! FUNNY JOKE)[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: NEXT FEST + Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello sightseers,

I am here to announce MAGEYE will be entering this year's Next Fest in June. If you happen to know any lacklustre sightseers within your vicinity, it may be worth traumatising them and letting them catch a glimpse of the glory of MAGEYE in time for the event. "Life's no fun without a good scare", as some say...

Traumatisation aside, this game is a very niche project and it relies heavily on word of mouth. I cannot imagine a game about stealing eyes within a story as raw and fucked up as this one, gaining any sort of mainstream attention.

As for a release date... Don't expect anything exact as things may shift, but currently I am predicting an October release. If you want to get a better idea of whatever this ambiguous nonsense means, it took just over two months for me to produce the demo, and the final game should be around 1-2 hours long.

Development is currently going smoothly, and you can all expect a more polished experience that doesn't lose any of its raw value, that substantially beats the demo in terms of how messed up it is.

I think I will stop writing here, as I have no more ideas to babble, nor say.

I will enjoy SEEING you all at the event two weeks from now. ;)

notes.title: MAGEYE Demo Update 1
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow sightseers!

I've made an update that adds a few a tweaks, some bug fixes, and an options menu that is now available when paused, which includes a much needed volume control. I send my deepest condolences to anyone who had their ears blasted off during your nefarious eye stealing.

As for the future, I have plans to add the option for other languages, and to release the game on Linux at some point. I am however currently prioritising completing the game right now, so don't expect this anytime soon until after the game is released. As for a release date, hell even I don't know when it'll be out. It's too early to say.

I would like to thank anyone that has played my demo, wishlisted the game, or just noticed my game in some form (even if it is severely fucked in places). Your choice to meddle within my monstrosities is equally flattering as well as disturbing.

Anyway... I need to get back work. Stay safe, and happy eye hunting!
